title: Marked high-zero counting gives the all-Dirichlet boundary 0.874858
description: Proves the canonical all-moduli Dirichlet zero-free bound by retaining prime-slot amplitudes in high-zero counting and combining the resulting gain with common-allocation width conservation. Overlapping prime pools are handled by collision partitions. The source estimate gains 33/20000 before explicit losses. Builds on the complete Cycle61 construction and the listed predecessor proofs; inherited source attribution is preserved.
